pages.title: Theoretical Dossier
pages.text: The middle chapters of my research: dense theory, half of it proven, half of it argued with myself in the margins. It is bound over the earlier empirical dossier, the way theory sits on observation. Exotic matter keeps the binding from aging, which is just as well.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Once a mind could improve itself, it could also read what I had built and extend it. I compiled the three theoretical volumes over the empirical dossier and fixed them with exotic matter, and the Research Nexus started asking questions I had not.
